run_f_gold: run the f_gold function to compute sequences of given length where every element equals twice the previous one
test_f_gold: test the f_gold function with integer pairs (m, n) and verify results against expected values
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function that uses dynamic programming to count valid sequences
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function which counts sequences of length n with elements doubling each step using a DP table
refactor_f_gold: refactor the f_gold function to replace the DP table with an optimized space-complexity approach
